x-fc-pending.title: Pending of the spec
x-fc-pending.description: Routes, fields, schemas, responses and events that the production API already has but the spec/funnelchat.json snapshot (the portal's full unified spec of 04-11) does not include, or includes with a shape production does not answer. The generator (`composer generate`, scripts/generate.php) adds them to the spec before generating the resources and types, only while the snapshot lacks them: when a new snapshot includes them, generation uses the snapshot's version and reports which entries in this file can be deleted. Every entry comes from the code of the tags running in production (`origin` and `sources` say which).

rules.paths: An operation (method + route) is added only if the snapshot does not have it.
rules.operationPatches: A patch adds properties to the body of a snapshot operation only while that operation meets the `while` condition.
rules.webhooks: An event is added if the snapshot does not have it, or replaces the snapshot's while it meets the `x-fc-replace-while` condition.
rules.responsePatches: A patch replaces the responses of a snapshot operation (all the 2xx ones, and any others it includes by code) only while that operation meets the `while` condition.
rules.webhookPatches: A patch adds properties to the `data` of an event (of every event with `type: "*"`, the ones of this layer included) only while the event does not include them (neither in its schema nor in its example); `required` makes them required in the type.
rules.components.schemas: The schemas in this layer start with `Pending` so they do not clash with the snapshot's.
rules.schemaPatches: A patch adds properties to a snapshot schema only while the schema does not include them.
rules.parameterPatches: A patch adds query parameters to a snapshot operation only while that operation does not declare them.
rules.conditions: `while` and `x-fc-replace-while` take top-level keys of the snapshot's operation or event, or JSON pointers into it (`/responses/200/content/application~1json/schema/type`), where `null` means absent or null: a correction stops by itself, and is reported as obsolete, once the snapshot changes the very thing it corrects.

x-fc-pending.origin: Reviewed on 22-10 against the code of the tags running in production, read with `git show <tag>:<archivo>` (read-only): conversations v1.18.10 @ a580a3d0, communities v2.34.52 @ 6f32f0b4, accounts v1.4.24 @ 300cc843 and api-edge v0.3.0 @ a1c5b350 (platform-gate v0.8.0 @ eab47f20). It started from the funnelchat-node layer (spec/pending.json on feat/inicial @ 88557ce); the accounts webhook entries from 16-10 were reviewed against v1.4.24. Reviewed again on 04-11 against the tags in production that day: accounts v1.5.97 @ 558332bc, conversations v1.19.7 @ 4e35ddb8, communities v2.35.5 @ 2be913d4, platform-gate v0.9.1 @ cc2cee4b and api-edge v0.3.0 @ a1c5b350 (still its latest tag; production runs its main @ 975d8154, deployed on 25-10, which also routes `/connect-links` and `/connect`). What changed for the first use (connecting a number, sending, knowing when it was read, receiving, groups and workspaces): the numbers by API now come from accounts' code, sending to a group and reading its action are in, the participant events say that `campaign` can be `null`, and every event carries `data.workspace_id`. Phase 2, the same day: the snapshot became the portal's full unified spec (developers-portal main @ c90565e4, the merge of PR #33 deployed as v0.6.0, the same tree as feat/primer-uso @ 4838fb5 where it was built; generated/specs/funnelchat-completa.json), made of accounts v1.5.97, conversations v1.19.7 and communities v2.35.5. What it brings was deleted from here. What stays is what it lacks (the forms routes, rotate-secret, sending to a group, the events accounts delivers that are not in its `webhooks`, `data.workspace_id`) and corrections where its shapes, inferred by Scramble, are not what production answers; each correction carries the condition that ends it.

PendingDeviceCapabilities.description: What the number can do through the API. Pending of the spec (accounts v1.4.24).

groups.description: All `false` on an official number without the groups beta or in coexistence.

add_participants.description: `direct` on a QR number, `invite` on an official number.

PendingMessageError.description: Why it failed. If Funnelchat decided it, `code` is `null`, `title` is a text and `reason` gives the reason; if WhatsApp reported it, `code` and `title` are Meta's and `reason` is `null`.

PendingForm.description: A version of a WhatsApp form. `id` is the version's ID; `family_id` is the form's.

updated_at.description: Send it as `expected_updated_at` when you save, so you do not overwrite another change.

PendingExternalReference.description: Your own reference for the number (for example, your customer's ID). Free text, it can repeat. It comes back in the number, in the list filter and in every `device.*` event.

PendingConnectionType.description: How the number is connected: `qr` (WhatsApp Web session, not official), `coexistence` (WhatsApp Cloud API alongside the WhatsApp Business app), `dedicated` (WhatsApp Cloud API only), or `null` when it cannot be told.

PendingDeviceCreate.description: Kept so `@phpstan-import-type PendingDeviceCreate` keeps working: since the full spec of 04-11 it is the snapshot's `StoreDeviceRequest`.

qr_code.description: A PNG image as a data URI (`data:image/png;base64,…`), or `null` once the number is connected.

expires_in.description: Seconds before asking for the QR again: 5 with a QR (show it and scan it right away), 3 while the session starts, 0 once connected.

PendingConnectLinkErrorCode.description: Why the link did not complete, or `null`.

PendingConnectLinkCreate.description: Kept so `@phpstan-import-type PendingConnectLinkCreate` keeps working: since the full spec of 04-11 it is the snapshot's `StoreConnectLinkRequest`.

PendingConnectLink.description: A single-use link where your customer creates or reconnects a number, without a Funnelchat session. A `meta` link tolerates retries: after a Facebook or Meta failure it stays `pending` so your customer can try again on the page, and the fifth failure makes it `failed` (`facebook_auth_failed` or `meta_error`); `quota_exceeded`, `trial_number_blocked` and `number_not_owned` close it at the first attempt.

url.description: `https://<public host>/connect/<token>` in the answer of the create; `null` when you read the link (the token is not stored).

device_id.description: The number to reconnect, or the one it created once `completed`; `null` otherwise.

country.description: The country given when creating the link, or `null`.

PendingConnectLinkId.description: The connect link that connected this number the last time, or `null`. In `device.connected`, the link of that connection.

PendingWorkspaceId.description: The workspace of the event: the one it was routed to, which is the workspace of every subscription that receives it (a subscription receives only the events of its workspace: the one of the API key that created it, or the one chosen in the panel). An account with a single workspace gets the id of its default workspace. `null` only for an account without any workspace.

uid.description: The group's WhatsApp id (`…@g.us`): the `{group}` of `POST /api/v1/groups/{group}/messages`.

identity.description: The phone, or the WhatsApp id (`…@lid`) when there is no phone.

PendingGroupMessageCreate.description: A text or a single file, sent to the group now. Polls, events, stickers, contacts and locations are not accepted; fields that are not listed here are ignored.

device_id.description: The number that sends, connected. A QR number must be an admin of the group (`422 device_not_group_admin`); an official number must be the group's own number (`422 device_not_group_number`).

text.description: Required with `type: text`, not allowed with the others.

media_url.description: Required with `image`, `video`, `audio` and `document`, not allowed with `text`: a public `https` URL (default port, no credentials) whose extension WhatsApp accepts for that type.

PendingGroupActionAccepted.description: The action was accepted and runs later, at the number's pace.

action_id.description: Read it with `GET /api/v1/groups/actions/{action}`; it is also `action.uuid` in `group_action.completed` and `group_action.failed`.

PendingGroupActionResult.description: It depends on the action. Sending a message: `message.uid`, the message's id in WhatsApp. Creating a group or renewing its link: `invite_link`. Actions with a list of phones: `participants`, one per person. The others: `{}`.

PendingGroupAction.description: An action on a group requested through the API, with its state and its result.

device_id.description: The number that runs it; `null` if it is no longer of the key's workspace.

post.summary: Send a message to a group now
post.description:
Sends a text or a file to a WhatsApp group of the account, from one of its numbers. It is asynchronous: it answers `202` with `action_id` and the message goes out right after, at the pace of the number (a QR number sends at the pace of the Low-speed scheduled messages). Learn how it ended with `GET /api/v1/groups/actions/{action}` (`result.message.uid` is the message's id in WhatsApp) or with `group_action.completed` / `group_action.failed`. With an official number, the 24-hour service window and the number's quality are checked before accepting. There is no idempotency key: retrying after a `5xx` can send it twice.

`{group}` is the group's WhatsApp id (`uid`, `…@g.us`), from `GET /api/v1/groups`.

**Pending of the spec** (communities v2.35.5).

202.description: Accepted: it goes out right after.

402.description: The account's plan does not include it.

404.description: `device_not_found` or `group_not_found` (also when they are of another workspace).

422.description: `device_not_connected`, `device_not_group_admin` (QR number), `device_not_group_number` (official number), `unsupported_group_type` (a community or a channel), `unsupported_type`, `provider_unsupported` (with `requires`), `window_closed`, `number_restricted`, or a validation error with `errors`.

429.description: `too_many_pending_actions`: the number already has 50 actions open; or the limit of 30 requests per minute.

get.description:
The state (`queued`, `running`, `completed` or `failed`) and the result of an action requested through the API, such as a message sent to a group. An action of another account or of another workspace answers the same `404 action_not_found`.

**Pending of the spec** (communities v2.35.5).

200.description: The registered message (`status: queued`), never `null` for an API key: `ApiKeySendResponse::message()` always answers `{"message": <object>}` (a message that could not be queued arrives as `failed` with `error.reason` `not_queued`; one that could not be registered is a `500`).

The links, paginated, newest first. `url` is always there and `null`: it carries the token, which is only in the answer of the create (ConnectLinkResource).

Empty body. The deletion is physical and frees the quota; it emits `device.deleted`.
The contacts with the tag, paginated: `ContactResource` items (TagController::contacts → listContacts).

post.description: The delivery status of a sent 1:1 message changed. One notice per transition, never one that goes backward; `queued` never arrives here. You must request it explicitly in `events` (`*` does not include it).

message_id.description: The message's `id` in the contact's history.

device_id.description: The number on your account that sent the message.

client_reference.description: The `client_reference` you included in the send, or `null`.

post.description: One of the account's numbers connected: when the QR code was scanned or when a WhatsApp Cloud number finished onboarding, also from a connect link. With `device.connection`, `device.external_reference` and `connect_link_id` (the link of this connection, or `null`).

One of the account's numbers disconnected and can no longer send or receive: a QR session closed or protected from a shadow ban, an official number left without registration, or disconnected in the panel. With `reason`, `device.connection`, `device.external_reference` and `connect_link_id` (the last link that connected the number, or `null`).

A number was deleted from the account (once per number, after the deletion, with the number as it was; `connect_link_id` is the last link that connected it, or `null`). The deletion is physical and frees the quota; an official number loses the app subscription but is not deregistered from Meta; a QR number's session is closed.

The aggregated health of an official number changed, according to Meta (not on every Meta webhook; `connect_link_id` is the last link that connected it, or `null`). The reason is read with `GET /api/v1/devices/{device}/health`.

A contact completed a WhatsApp form. It can arrive more than once: deduplicate by `id`.

value.description: Dates as ISO strings; texts up to 600 characters.

post.description: A contact wrote to one of the account's WhatsApp numbers. `device_id` is the number that received it: the same `device_id` you send with to answer from that number, `null` if the message has no number.

id.description: The message's `id` in the contact's history.

text.description: The text or the caption; `null` when there is none.

phone.description: Your number that received it, E.164.
